column1: # Neutral names for third-party trademarks in interface text (brand.toml [ui] neutral_terms).
# Upstream names features after Microsoft's (WordArt and SmartArt are Microsoft trademarks;
# Researcher and Immersive Reader are its feature names). The ribbon itself is fine — WPS Office
# ships one in the Mac App Store — but a trademark in the UI invites a complaint, and Apple removes
# apps over those. LibreOffice avoids them the same way ("Fontwork").
# Columns, TAB-separated: language code (* = every language), match (= whole text, ~ = anywhere in
# the text), upstream text, replacement. Language rows are tried before * rows; whole-text rows
# before anywhere rows. Applied after translation (crates/brand/src/lib.rs, `neutral`).
